note: One swing of a unit's own weapon: what it is aimed at, when it lands, and the missile it throws.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit swung at, or zero where the swing is aimed at a point instead.

fields.name: timing
fields.note: How far the swing is shifted from the unit's own rhythm. Read it as a signed hundredth of a second by taking the byte, subtracting 128, and dividing by 100, so 128 means no shift.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this swing throws will answer to.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's attacks this is.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the swing is aimed, along one ground axis. Carried in the units a path uses rather than in world units, and always whole. spec/movement.md says how the two relate.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: Where the swing is aimed, in height. Carried in world units.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the swing is aimed, along the other ground axis. It shares the reading of the first.
